preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.text: These follow you to every device.
preferences.nameNote: Your name shows in the platform’s Activity.

access.noAccessText: You are signed in as <email></email>. This account has no access here.

twoStep.enrolText: Platform staff sign in with a second step. This takes two minutes and you only do it once.
twoStep.scan: Open an authenticator app on your phone and scan this code.
twoStep.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
twoStep.cannotScan: Cannot scan? Type this key instead:
twoStep.enterCode: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows
twoStep.backupText: Each code signs you in once if you lose your phone. Keep them somewhere safe and offline. This is the only time they are shown in full.
twoStep.saved: I saved these codes. I understand I cannot see them again, only make new ones.

organisations.title: Organisations
organisations.deletedIn: Deleted in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
organisations.emptyText: Create the first one and invite its Owner. The Owner then invites the rest of the team.
organisations.noMatchText: Pick another status or clear the search.
organisations.createText: We create it and email the Owner an invitation in their language. It is active at once and shows Waiting for Owner until they join.
organisations.name: Name
organisations.slugHint: Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens. Used in links. It never changes.
organisations.slugInvalid: Use lower-case letters, digits and single hyphens. Start and end with a letter or digit.
organisations.slugTaken: This slug is taken. Try another.
organisations.emailInvalid: Enter an email address like name@company.example.
organisations.waitingPending: The link to <email></email> works until {date}. Nobody can sign in until the Owner joins.
organisations.waitingExpired: The invitation to <email></email> expired on {date}. Nobody can sign in until an Owner joins.
organisations.ownerlessHint: If the Owner joined as a member, <link>open their user page</link> and make them an Owner.
organisations.suspendedText: Reason: {reason}. Members do not see this reason.
organisations.closedTitle: Closed on {closedAt}. You can reopen it until {reopenableUntil}. After that it is deleted.
organisations.beingDeleted: <bdi>{name}</bdi> is being deleted and can’t be reopened.
organisations.purgedText: Its members, invitations and data are gone. Activity keeps what happened.
organisations.renameText: The new name shows to its members at once. The slug <slug></slug> never changes.
organisations.notActiveText: It is closed or being deleted.
organisations.suspendText: Its {count, plural, one {# member loses} other {# members lose}} access at once. Data and memberships are kept. You can reactivate it at any time.
organisations.reasonHint: Required, up to {max} characters. Members never see it.
organisations.suspendedToast: Its {count, plural, one {# member} other {# members}} cannot sign in.
organisations.reactivateText: Its {count, plural, one {# member} other {# members}} can sign in again at once. The reason is cleared. The suspension stays in Activity.
organisations.signInAgain: Its {count, plural, one {# member} other {# members}} can sign in again.
organisations.reactivateClosedText: A closed organisation is reopened, not reactivated. Use Reopen before its deletion date.
organisations.closeText: Its {count, plural, one {# member loses} other {# members lose}} access at once. Pending invitations are cancelled. You can reopen it for a limited time. After that it is deleted with all its data.
organisations.closedText: You can reopen it until {date}. Pending invitations were cancelled.
organisations.reopenText: It becomes active and its {count, plural, one {# member} other {# members}} can sign in again. Invitations cancelled at closing stay cancelled; invite those people again.
organisations.periodEndedText: <bdi>{name}</bdi> is being deleted. The page has been refreshed.
organisations.notClosedText: Someone reopened it already. The page has been refreshed.
organisations.inviteText: A new email goes out with a new link. It replaces the pending invitation, also when the email is different.
organisations.emailHint: The last invited address. Change it to invite someone else.
organisations.hasOwnerText: The Owner joined just now. The page has been refreshed.

users.title: Users
users.noMatchText: Pick another status or clear the search.
users.suspendedText: They are refused on every request. Their memberships are kept.
users.noMemberships: Not a member of any organisation.
users.makeOwnerText: They get every permission in <bdi>{organisation}</bdi>. The organisation’s Activity shows that the platform did this.
users.alreadyOwnerRaced: <bdi>{name}</bdi> is already an Owner of <bdi>{organisation}</bdi>. The page has been refreshed.
users.organisationNotActive: <bdi>{organisation}</bdi> is not active. Reactivate or reopen it first.
users.notAMember: <bdi>{name}</bdi> is no longer a member of <bdi>{organisation}</bdi>.
users.wasDeletedText: A deleted user has no name.
users.renameText: Fixes a typo or a name change. The new names show in every organisation at once. Past Activity shows the new names too.
users.suspendText: They are refused on their next request, everywhere. Their memberships are kept. You can reactivate them at any time.
users.lastOwnerWarningText: While they are suspended, nobody there can invite, change roles or remove members.
users.suspendedToast: They are refused on their next request.
users.isSystemAdminText: Remove them from System admins first.
users.reactivateText: They can sign in again at once, in every organisation they belong to.
users.deleteText: They leave every organisation. Their email and names are erased. Activity keeps their entries as Deleted user. This cannot be undone.
users.cannotDeleteText: They are the last Owner of {count, plural, one {# organisation} other {# organisations}}. Make someone else an Owner there, or close them, then try again.
users.joinedMeanwhile: <bdi>{name}</bdi> joined an organisation while this ran.

systemAdmins.title: System admins
systemAdmins.text: System admins manage every organisation and user on the platform. Each one signs in with an authenticator app.
systemAdmins.name: Name
systemAdmins.rootHint: Root admins come from the platform’s configuration.
systemAdmins.cannotRemoveSelf: You can’t remove yourself. Ask another system admin.
systemAdmins.addText: Type the person’s full email address. There are no suggestions.
systemAdmins.memberOf: Member of {count, plural, one {# organisation} other {# organisations}}
systemAdmins.noUser: No user has this email. They must sign in once first.
systemAdmins.manyUsers: More than one user has this email. Ask a developer to check the accounts.
systemAdmins.confirmText: They can manage every organisation and user on the platform. They set up an authenticator app on their next sign-in.
systemAdmins.alreadyAdminRaced: <bdi>{name}</bdi> is already a system admin. The page has been refreshed.
systemAdmins.removeText: They can no longer open the platform. Their memberships in organisations stay.
systemAdmins.noLongerAdmin: <bdi>{name}</bdi> is no longer a system admin.
systemAdmins.rootCannotRemove: Root admins can’t be removed here.
systemAdmins.reverifyText: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app. We ask again because your last check was a while ago.

activity.title: Activity
activity.emptyText: Changes to organisations, users and system admins appear here.
activity.tenantText: The platform’s entries about this organisation.

tenant.owner_made: {owner, select, named {<actor></actor> made <member></member> an Owner of <target></target>.} deletedUser {<actor></actor> made <member>Deleted user</member> an Owner of <target></target>.} other {<actor></actor> made <member>a member</member> an Owner of <target></target>.}}
tenant.purge_warned: The Owners of <target></target> were warned that it will be deleted on {date}.

user.renamed: {self, select, yes {<actor></actor> changed their name.} other {<actor></actor> renamed the user <target></target>.}}
user.deleted: {actorKind, select, platform {A user was deleted.} other {<actor></actor> deleted a user.}}
